svg.title: Code metrics for the rescue
svg.desc: Use cyclomatic complexity tools such as lizard and the CRAP index to identify risky code and guide refactoring and cleanup in each PR.

g.text: Cyclomatic complexity tools, such as lizard.
CRAP index: identify complex and untested code.
Make refactoring and cleanup part of the PR.
Find functions with too many independent execution paths.
Combine complexity with test coverage to prioritize attention.
Measure → add behavioral tests → simplify → verify.

svg.text: Use metrics to guide judgment, not to chase a score.
